{"script":"mkdir temp_workspace
find /working > temp_workspace/all_entries.txt
awk -F/ '$NF == "workspace"' temp_workspace/all_entries.txt > temp_workspace/matching_names.txt
touch temp_workspace/matching_attrs.txt

grep "^regular" temp_workspace/matching_attrs.txt | cut -d' ' -f3- > temp_workspace/regular_matches.txt || true
head -n 1 temp_workspace/regular_matches.txt > temp_workspace/selected_match.txt
cat temp_workspace/regular_matches.txt
"}
